hallTicket.title: प्रवेश पत्र (Hall ticket)
hallTicket.name: Candidate’s name
hallTicket.subject: Subject (code)
hallTicket.ins1: Reach the examination hall at least 20 minutes before the paper begins.
hallTicket.ins2: Bring this admit card to every paper and show it when asked. Without it you may not be allowed to sit the paper.
hallTicket.ins3: Mobile phones, smart watches, calculators and other electronic devices are not allowed in the hall.
hallTicket.ins4: Bring your own pens, pencils and geometry box. Do not borrow or lend anything during the paper.
hallTicket.ins5: Write your roll number only in the space given on the answer book. Do not write anything on the question paper.
hallTicket.ins6: You may not leave the hall during the first hour or the last 15 minutes of the paper.

duty.title: Invigilation duty chart

yearCard.title: Annual report card
yearCard.how: Each column is the % in that kind of exam; the final % weighs them by the share shown under each heading.

yearCard.noMarks: No published marks for this session yet.

seating.title: Seating & invigilation
seating.subtitle: For each exam session: rooms, who sits where (classes mixed so neighbours are never from the same class) and who invigilates.
seating.noExamsHint: Set up an exam and its papers in Exam schedule first.
seating.noSessions: No papers with a date and time
seating.noSessionsHint: Give the exam's papers a date and start time in Exam schedule — each date and time is one session to seat.
seating.short: {{seats}} seats for {{needed}} students — {{short}} short. Add rooms.
seating.noRooms: No rooms yet. Add classrooms and halls in Timetable › Rooms.

mixHint.SEAT: No two neighbours — beside or behind — from the same class.
mixHint.COLUMN: Each column of seats is one class; the next column is another.
mixHint.NONE: One class after another, in roll-number order.

seating.gapHint: Leave every other seat on a bench empty.
seating.keepsLocked: Seats you moved by hand stay where they are.
seating.regenerateHint: Everyone not moved by hand gets a new seat, and the invigilators not chosen by hand are picked again.
seating.generateAllConfirm: Seat every session of this exam?
seating.generateAllHint: Every session not yet published is seated with these rooms and rules. Published sessions are left as they are.
seating.invigilatorRules: Never a teacher of a subject written in the room, never someone on leave, fewest duties first.
seating.pickedHint: {{name}} — now click a seat: a free one to move there, a taken one to swap.
seating.warnUnseated_one: {{count}} student has no seat — add a room or a seat.
seating.warnUnseated_other: {{count}} students have no seat — add a room or seats.
seating.warnClashes_one: {{count}} pair of neighbours from the same class (red).
seating.warnClashes_other: {{count}} pairs of neighbours from the same class (red).
seating.warnOwn_one: {{count}} invigilator teaches a subject written in their room.
seating.warnOwn_other: {{count}} invigilators teach a subject written in their room.
seating.warnAway_one: {{count}} invigilator is on leave that day.
seating.warnAway_other: {{count}} invigilators are on leave that day.
seating.warnNew_one: {{count}} student joined after the seating was made — make it again to seat them.
seating.warnNew_other: {{count}} students joined after the seating was made — make it again to seat them.
seating.publishHint: The seating is fixed and the invigilators see their duties. Take it back to draft to change it.
seating.unpublishConfirm: Take the seating back to draft?
seating.unpublishHint: It can be changed again; print the charts again afterwards.
seating.clearHint: The seats and invigilators of this session are removed.
seating.unlockAll: Free the seats moved by hand
seating.unlocked: Seats freed — the next run may move them.
seating.editHint: Click a student, then another seat: a free seat moves them, a taken one swaps the two. Moved seats keep their place when the seating is made again.
seating.spreadHint: Each room gets its share by size — off: fill one room, then the next. A seat is left empty rather than seat two of the same class together.
seating.hallNotMarked: Not marked yet — everyone starts as present
seating.hallOnlyInvigilators: Only this room’s invigilators can mark its attendance.

yearResults.title: Year-end results
yearResults.subtitle: Every published exam of {{year}} combined by its weightage — the final result per subject and overall.
yearResults.noClasses: No classes in your scope this year.
yearResults.weightsNot100: The weightages add up to {{total}}%, not 100% — fix them in Exam setup.
yearResults.noWeights: No exam type carries a weightage yet. Set the weightage of each exam type in Exams › Exam setup.
yearResults.soFarNote: Result so far. {{missing}} — not published yet, so the shares above are scaled over the exams there are. It can be published once every weighted exam is.
yearResults.readyNote: Every weighted exam is published. Check the result and publish it — the report cards and the parent app show it from then on.
yearResults.publishedNote: Published by {{name}} on {{at}}. Marks or weightage changed later won’t change it unless you unpublish.
yearResults.cantPublish: Every exam type with a weightage needs a published exam first.
